**Finding: compliant** — no redline proposed.

Section 18 (Insurance) is a dedicated vendor-side clause that satisfies the preferred position on every material term:

| Playbook (preferred) | § 18.1 |
|---|---|
| CGL USD 1M / 2M aggregate | ✔ USD 1M per occurrence / 2M aggregate |
| Professional (E&O) USD 2M | ✔ USD 2M |
| Cyber/privacy USD 5M (processing Customer Data) | ✔ USD 5M — and Vendor is a hosting provider processing Customer Data |
| Workers' comp as required by law | ✔ plus employer's liability USD 1M |
| Certificates on request | ✔ § 18.2 |

Coverage runs at Vendor's own expense for the term plus one year, and § 18.2 adds helpful extras beyond the model language: reputable insurers, primary to Customer's insurance where customary, advance notice of cancellation or material reduction, and an express statement that insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities. Nothing here sits at or below the fallback, so no changes are warranted.
